explanation: The ants chew the leaves into a mulch that feeds their fungus garden, then eat the fungus. They weed out moulds and use bacteria on their bodies as natural pesticides.

claims.text: Leafcutter ants use cut leaves to grow a fungus garden, which they eat.
Leafcutter ants do not grow moss, seedlings or algae in their nests.
Leafcutter ants chew leaves into a pulp that nourishes their fungus.
Leafcutter ants remove harmful moulds from their gardens and carry bacteria that produce antifungal compounds.
